title: From Grammar Deltas to Token Masks: Incremental Constrained Decoding under Runtime Grammar Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.32807v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Grammar-constrained decoding enables large language models to generate outputs that satisfy formal constraints, but in code and domain-specific language generation, the relevant constraints are not always fully available before decoding and may emerge progressively from new declarations, inferred type information, or runtime analysis feedback. Existing structured-decoding engines efficiently handle fixed, predeclared, or previously seen constraint structures; however, when a first-seen grammar update changes the parser state induced by an already committed prefix, the straightforward solution reconstructs the constraint state under the updated grammar, repeating parsing work already performed over the prefix. We introduce GramDelta, an incremental framework for constrained decoding with append-only runtime grammar updates. GramDelta maintains parse state over the committed prefix and propagates only changes induced by newly added grammar

translated_title: 从语法增量到词元掩码：运行时语法演化下的增量式约束解码
translated_abstract: 语法约束解码使大语言模型能够生成满足形式化约束的输出，但在代码和领域特定语言生成中，相关约束并不总是在解码前完全可用，而可能随着新的声明、推断的类型信息或运行时分析反馈逐步涌现。现有的结构化解码引擎能够高效处理固定的、预先声明的或之前见过的约束结构；然而，当首次出现的语法更新改变了已提交前缀所诱导的解析器状态时，直接的解决方案是在更新后的语法下重建约束状态，从而重复前缀上已经执行过的解析工作。我们提出了GramDelta，一个支持仅追加式运行时语法更新的增量约束解码框架。GramDelta在已提交前缀上维护解析状态，并仅传播由新添加语法所引起的变更。
tldr: 提出了GramDelta框架，通过在已提交前缀上维护解析状态并仅增量传播新增语法引起的变更，实现了运行时语法演化下的高效约束解码，避免了重复解析工作。
en_tdlr: GramDelta, an incremental constrained decoding framework that maintains parse state over committed prefixes and propagates only changes induced by newly added grammar, enabling efficient decoding under runtime grammar evolution without redundant re-parsing.
